# Las Vegas Music School
> Private one-to-one music lessons in 18 instruments for ages 5 to adult at eight studios in Las Vegas and Henderson, NV, and online on Zoom or Google Meet. $200/month (30 min weekly) or $400/month (60 min weekly). Every new student starts with a complimentary Initial Assessment. Phone (702) 518-1081.

## Lessons
- [Piano lessons](https://www.lasvegasmusicschools.com/piano-lessons-las-vegas/)
- [Guitar lessons](https://www.lasvegasmusicschools.com/guitar-lessons-las-vegas/)
- [Drum lessons](https://www.lasvegasmusicschools.com/drum-lessons-las-vegas/)
- [Violin, viola & cello lessons](https://www.lasvegasmusicschools.com/violin-lessons-las-vegas/)
- [Adult lessons](https://www.lasvegasmusicschools.com/adult-music-lessons/)
- [Online lessons](https://www.lasvegasmusicschools.com/online-music-lessons/)
